body:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH: model-catalog: active revision mismatch detected for customer-prod (rev: 2026-03-14T09:20Z expected rev: 2026-03-14T09:00Z)

pagerduty: [ALERT] service=model-catalog severity=high — tokenizer mismatch rate > 30% across 3 regions. Escalation policy applied: oncall_eng -> eng_sre -> eng_platform.

Maya Chen: Acked. I'm on it — pulling logs and recent catalog promotions.

Devin Park: I'm switching to PD OnCall mode. Maya — any customer-facing traffic spike or errors?

Maya Chen: Yes — error logs show tokenization exceptions in route /v1/generate for model-id redwood/open-llm-3-small: "Tokenizer mismatch: expected 50265 tokens, got 0". Appears catalog promoted a revision that changed tokenizer mapping.

Alex Ruiz: Copy. Which revision was promoted? Any deploys in the last 15m?

Maya Chen: Promotion timestamp 2026-03-14T09:17Z by automation job (catalog-promote). New revision metadata: 
```
model: redwood/open-llm-3-small
rev: 2026-03-14T09:17Z
tokenizer: subword-v2
prev_rev_tokenizer: subword-v1
defaults: {max_tokens: 1024, truncation: head}
```

Priya Patel: That tokenizer change isn't backward compatible with existing saved prompts and runtime assumptions. We should roll back to prev_rev immediately.

Maya Chen: Agreed. I can pin traffic to rev 2026-03-14T09:00Z via the routing API. Doing that now.

Maya Chen: /api/routing/pin -d '{"model":"redwood/open-llm-3-small","revision":"2026-03-14T09:00Z","duration":"15m"}' -> 200 OK

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: Maya Chen acknowledged the incident. Escalation paused.

Devin Park: Nice. Priya please prepare a config patch for the promotion job to validate tokenizer changes before promote. Alex — can you take on the rollback of the catalog entry so the automation doesn't re-promote?

Alex Ruiz: On it. Rolling back catalog entry and locking the promote pipeline. Running: 
```
# rollback cmd
catalogctl rollback --model redwood/open-llm-3-small --to-rev 2026-03-14T09:00Z --by oncall
catalogctl lock-promotion --model redwood/open-llm-3-small --reason "mismatch detected"
```

Support Liaison: Customers impacted: 4 enterprise tenants reported degraded generation (timeouts + malformed outputs). CS opened two Sev2 escalations; they've been notified we're rolling back.

Priya Patel: Drafting validator: compare tokenizer hash between model artifact and expected tokenizer in catalog metadata. If mismatch, fail promote and send alert instead of auto-promote. Patch ready for review.

Maya Chen: Observability: tokenization exception rate dropped from 32% to 2% since pin. Latency for affected route back to normal. Sending a short runbook note to CS.

Devin Park: Good containment. Let's run a quick smoke across a sample prompt set to confirm outputs deterministic and no truncation regressions. Maya, can you run evals?

Maya Chen: Kicking off eval harness against pinned rev (2026-03-14T09:00Z). Results: 0 tokenizer errors in 500 samples, model outputs stable.

Alex Ruiz: Rollback complete and promotion lock in place. I've also added a temporary denylist for that automation job until PR with validator merges.

Priya Patel: Pushing PR: add tokenizer validator + unit tests + a fallback policy that rejects promotions that change tokenizer without manual approval. PR: https://git.internal/r/repro/catalog/12345

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: Incident status=acknowledged, assigned_to=Maya Chen, priority=high.

Support Liaison: CS updated customers and provided ETA 30m for follow-up. No data leakage, only degraded outputs. Customers appreciate fast response.

Devin Park: Next steps: 1) Keep traffic pinned for 30m while validator PR lands. 2) After PR merges, run a canary promote to staging, 3) run broader smoke tests, then unpin. Assign owners: PR owner=Priya, rollback/lock handled by Alex, monitoring by Maya.

Maya Chen: I'll keep monitoring metrics and will escalate if token errors > 1% or latency > 2x baseline.

Priya Patel: FYI added config diff check to pipeline to raise a human approval request when tokenizer field changes.

Alex Ruiz: Noted. Also adding a temporary alert rule to catch tokenizer hash drifts post-promotion.

Devin Park: Thanks all — good containment. I'll start post-incident notes and link to oncall timeline. Closing PD alert after validation window.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert resolved by Maya Chen at 2776543399.

Maya Chen: Closing thread — will follow up with a summary doc in #incidents in 1 hour. :white_check_mark:
